Consider a plate of mass $M$ that occupies the region $D$ in the second quadrant bounded by the polar circles $r=1,$ $r=\sqrt{3},$ and the coordinate axes, as shown above. The mass density at any point is proportional to the square of its distance from the origin. Find the moment of inertia of the plate about the $x$-axis.
